scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic, quantifies over arbitrary slices, and separates the dual-profile lower bound from a coordinate-slice upper bound. No finite experiment or search failure is used as proof of the theorem or of novelty.
limitations: Only real Banach spaces and \(1<p<\infty\) are covered.
Every summand is assumed to have the Daugavet property; no assertion is made for general absolute sums or for the \(\Delta\)-constant.
Originality is supported by focused searches and inspection of the principal full texts, not by an exhaustive theorem database.

title: Exact pointwise Daugavet constants for arbitrary finite and infinite \(\ell_p\)-sums
